subtitulo: A 2-page sample PDF used to test the store
descripcion_corta: Internal test product. A short sample PDF that verifies checkout, redirect and download work end to end.
descripcion_larga_md:
## What this is

This is an **internal test product**. It exists only to check that the full purchase flow works:

1. The checkout opens with the right name, price and cover.
2. After paying, you are redirected to the download page.
3. The file downloads correctly.

## Who it's for

Nobody, really. If you can see this page, please don't buy it.
